features.feature_value: Mentions political figure(s) and opposition party/ideology in blame/redemption context
features.rationale: Direct reference to specific partisan actors and ideological group indicates targeted partisan directionality.

features.feature_value: Expresses punishment fantasy (prison/rotting in a cell) for political opponents
features.evidence_span: "hope that at least Trump would be out of office" ... "on his way to prison"
features.rationale: Linked-fate moderation cues often include extreme personal fate language toward political targets.

features.feature_value: Uses constitutional amendment wording to argue gun-rights interpretation
features.evidence_span: "the Right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed"
features.rationale: Citing the Second Amendment and quoting its text grounds the post in a specific policy/rights debate.

features.feature_value: Frames amendment in terms of assault weapons and killing schoolchildren
features.evidence_span: "allow a man-child to buy himself an assault weapon" ... "slaughter schoolkids"
features.rationale: Directly ties guns to school violence, a salient linked-fate moderation topic.

features.feature_value: Uses moral condemnation with afterlife threat language
features.rationale: Strong moralized invective increases intensity and can be a cue for removal.

features.feature_value: Accuses an entire party of selling souls to the devil
features.evidence_span: "all republicans sol(led) their souls to devil trump"
features.rationale: Apocalyptic/diabolic attribution is aggressive, party-wide, and adversarial in semantic framing.

features.feature_value: Mocks negotiation/priorities by contrasting with affordability/elections concerns
features.evidence_span: "Please ignore the high prices" ... "I got all the time in the world"
features.rationale: Irony-like critique of a political statement using contrasted priorities suggests persuasive/argumentative attack.

features.feature_value: Uses 'Surely' rhetorical question contrasting race-based decisions in policing/justice
features.evidence_span: "Surely a police officer who takes the side of one person... shouldn't be in the #police?"
features.rationale: A rhetorical question with a conditional setup signals confrontational evaluative intent.
